resources.string: Keeps a game\'s ping steady while Arqon downloads. The game goes over the best connection; downloads and torrents use the others.
Android asks once to allow a VPN connection. It is only used to see the chosen games\' traffic; nothing goes to a server of ours.
Choose at least one game below first.
A game is playing now. Downloads keep off this connection while another one is available.
Waiting for a game to start.
Only the apps you tick go through the game mode. Everything else on the phone is untouched.
No connection found. Turn on Wi-Fi or mobile data.
To add speed, use Wi-Fi together with mobile data, or a phone with two SIM cards that can both use data.
Not every phone can use both SIM cards for data at the same time. Arqon asks Android for each SIM and uses the ones that answer.
Allow access to the phone state, so Arqon can tell your SIM cards apart and ask for each one.
Android did not give this network. On many phones only one SIM can use data at a time, or this connection is off.
Report copied. Paste it into a message.
Mobile data is switched off in the phone\'s settings, so Android gives no SIM to apps. Turn on mobile data.

Mobile data is on, but this phone does not give the SIM to apps while Wi-Fi is connected. Try: Settings → Developer options → Mobile data always active. If the phone has no such option, the maker\'s firmware blocks it and only one connection can be used here.
Nothing here yet. Paste a link above, or open a website in the Browser tab.
That is not a link Arqon can download.
That magnet link is not valid.
That is not a valid .torrent file.
That torrent is already in the list.
Use the SIM cards only while there is no Wi-Fi.
The browser shows websites as a computer does. Some sites hide download links from phones.
Uses your upload speed and mobile data. Off by default.
Lets Arqon save into the public Downloads folder, where your file manager shows it. Without it, files go to the app\'s own folder.
Needed to keep downloading in the background.
Samsung and some other phones put background apps to sleep, which stops downloads when the screen is off or a game is in front. Set Arqon to Unrestricted.
Battery: unrestricted. Downloads keep running in the background.
Samsung: Settings, Battery, Background usage limits, Never sleeping apps, then add Arqon.
Keeps Arqon running in the background and shows which connections are combined, also on the lock screen and while a game is on.

A label in the corner of the screen, also over games, that shows which connections are combined and the speed. It does not touch the game. Note: a game\'s own traffic still uses one connection; Arqon speeds up its own downloads, torrents and browser downloads.
Each step downloads a test file for 6 seconds and uses the data of the connection being tested.
That is %1$s× the fastest single connection.
Counted by Arqon while it runs. Allow usage access below for exact numbers.
Android keeps exact data counters. With this permission Arqon shows exact daily and monthly numbers, and which apps used the data. It all stays on your phone.
Apps that used the most data today
Android does not let an app switch between 5G, 4G, 3G and 2G. These buttons open the phone\'s own screens where you choose it.
This phone does not open that screen. Use Mobile network settings, or Settings, Connections, Mobile networks, Network mode.
Arqon warns you at 80% and when the limit is reached.
Shows the speed in the status bar, and the signal and today\'s data use in the notification.
KB/s and MB/s instead of Mbit/s.
Mobile data: 80% of today\'s limit used
Sends one small report a day: which features were used how many times, the phone model and which connections it gave to apps. No links, files, places or numbers. Off unless you allow it.
This build has no statistics server, so nothing is ever sent. The counts below stay on your phone.

Arqon can send one small anonymous report a day: how many times each feature was used, the phone model, the Android version and which connections (Wi-Fi, SIM) the phone gave to apps. It shows the developers which phones and features matter most.
Never sent: links, file names, websites, location, phone numbers or anything you download. You can see the exact report and switch it off in Settings.
Allow phone state so Arqon can show the network type (5G, 4G) and the mobile signal.
